Scope: Read every requested guidance/rubric window; all 4 complete EN/RU primary lessons; all 18 complete EN/RU context pairs; all 19 KANJIDIC2 records, radical evidence/header, 75 complete JMdict entries, 4 KanjiPedia entries, all 350 typed quiz rows, 12 proposals, 4 adjudications, 4 clarifications, 4 outside-limit observations, and 6 exact navigation diffs. Every window returned complete with exit 0. Did not read optional 夫.md/良.md; no web pages read.
C1 CLEAN: Readings, counts, canonical radicals, senses, examples and clearly labelled modern-shape mnemonics are supported in this bounded scope; no confirmed Japanese-fact defect.
C2 UNVERIFIED: All 6 edits are navigation-only with correct relative targets; the complete 好き label wrapper matches the pre-mutation amendment; existing visible text/metadata and CRLF are preserved. New lesson links target existing files. All 12 edges are supported only as introductory/source-core comparisons; ordinary active-negative quiz safety is not established, so no metadata retention is quiz approval.
C3 NEEDS FIX: Wife lesson's “несколько официальное” mistranslates “somewhat formal”; see F001.
N001夢→花 S-intro (ordinary negative U): shape/source-core comparison; current titles “сон; мечта” / “цветок” do not directly overlap.
N002夢→夜 U: introductory contrast is understandable, but dream/sleep and night/evening have strong domain affinity; not synonyms, yet negative safety remains unresolved.
N003夢→多 S-intro (ordinary negative U): shape comparison only; 多’s “много; многочисленный” does not answer 夢.
N004好→妹 U: shape comparison supported, but 妹（いも）has archaic “dear/beloved” senses adjacent to 好’s affection; current 妹 title is “младшая сестра”, but negative safety is not cleared.
N005好→姉 S-intro (ordinary negative U): shared 女 is a shape cue; sister/young-lady senses do not directly translate 好.
N006好→始 S-intro (ordinary negative U): shared 女 shape only; liking/favorable vs beginning are distinct.
N007妻→春 S-intro (ordinary negative U): shape comparison; spring/youth senses do not directly mean wife.
N008妻→書 S-intro (ordinary negative U): shape comparison; wife vs writing/book/document/letter are distinct.
N009妻→事 S-intro (ordinary negative U): shape comparison; broad “дело/обстоятельство” senses do not directly mean wife.
N010娘→始 S-intro (ordinary negative U): independent edge; 女 shape only, daughter/girl vs beginning.
N011娘→銀 S-intro (ordinary negative U): 良-shaped / 艮-like visual contrast; daughter vs silver are distinct.
N012娘→食 S-intro (ordinary negative U): lower-shape comparison only; daughter vs food/eating are distinct.
L001夢 SUPPORTED: selected meanings/readings and bounded 夢/悪夢/現実 contrast align with evidence.
L002好 SUPPORTED: selected readings, 好き grammar, 好む/好意 and mnemonic caveats align with evidence.
L003妻 SUPPORTED: 妻/夫妻 senses, readings and usage limits align with dictionary evidence.
L004娘 SUPPORTED: daughter/young-woman senses and 一人娘 limitation are accurate; “良-shaped, with a top dot” is a visual description, not etymology.
A001夢 SOURCE-SUPPORTED, BOUNDED: quoted 夢/悪夢/現実 senses match captured entries; no frequency claim.
A002好 SOURCE-SUPPORTED, BOUNDED: 好き/好む/好意/良い/好 and 格好 clarifications respect captured sense limits.
A003妻 SOURCE-SUPPORTED, BOUNDED: wife, garnish/accompaniment, 夫妻, 奥さん and 配偶者 are kept distinct.
A004娘 SOURCE-SUPPORTED, BOUNDED: 娘/一人娘/嬢/お嬢さん/息子 senses are bounded as stated.
NAV01 words/夢.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 夢 wrapper to ../kanji/夢.md.
NAV02 words/大好き.md: NAV-ONLY; whole 好き label to ../kanji/好.md, exact amendment-authorized wrapper.
NAV03 words/好き.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 好 wrapper to ../kanji/好.md.
NAV04 words/妻.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 妻 wrapper to ../kanji/妻.md.
NAV05 words/娘.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 娘 wrapper to ../kanji/娘.md.
NAV06 words/格好.md: NAV-ONLY; standalone 好 wrapper to ../kanji/好.md; 格 correctly unlinked because no card exists.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001–O004 LIMIT-NOT-NEW-GUARD; evening/night, favorable/good, spouse/female, and child/female/component overlaps are bounded observations, not new distractor edges (none is a distractor for its noted target).
Findings: F001 (C3, moderate, high confidence) — kanji/妻.md, “Частые слова”: “слово несколько официальное” suggests official status, not the dictionary’s “somewhat formal” register (JMdict 1496520). Learners may over-restrict 夫妻 to official contexts. Replace with “слово несколько формальное” or “довольно формальное”.
Optional: none.
Limits: No broader corpus, runtime quiz screens, or guard adjudication were reviewed; therefore all 12 ordinary active-negative uses remain unverified. No native-speaker certification. Read-only review only; no tests/builds/Git operations or file changes.
